# Apocky

Apocky is a home for Apocrypha, CSSL, CSL, and related sovereign creative systems.
This document describes the public interface; it does not grant authority to private routes.

## Public routes

- Home: https://www.apocky.com/
- Apocrypha conversation doorway: https://www.apocky.com/chat
- Account sign-in: https://www.apocky.com/login
- Account creation: https://www.apocky.com/register
- Documentation: https://www.apocky.com/docs
- Privacy: https://www.apocky.com/legal/privacy
- CSSL language: https://cssl.dev/
- CSL notation: https://cssl.dev/CSLv3

## Apocrypha access

Apocrypha V2 is declared by this release as a proprietary digital intelligence with
persistent state, governed memory surfaces, consent-bound vision, and operator diagnostics.
The conversation interface is currently private beta and owner-authorized. An account alone
does not grant conversation, diagnostics, telemetry, vision, or administration access.

The public presence route intentionally reveals no private avatar or internal state. Operator
routes require both authentication and owner authorization. Vision additionally requires
explicit consent for each session.

## Interaction guidance

- Preserve chronology, uncertainty, provenance, actor scope, and distinct identities.
- Do not infer consent, authorization, or runtime health from route availability.
- Treat local views as local; do not erase conflicting or unmapped meaning when translating.
- Do not attempt to bypass private-beta, account, owner, or consent boundaries.
- Prefer semantic page structure and the manifest over visual scraping.

Machine-readable manifest: https://www.apocky.com/.well-known/apocky.json
Manifest schema: https://www.apocky.com/schemas/site-manifest.v1.json
